text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was able to get some proper rest, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Or rather, should I say I had an excess 
of energy? Last night, my daydreaming 
about Umamusume scenarios was just too 
productive... Kuhihi♪"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My whole body's boiling up... Whoaaa~~...

She must have been too excited to sleep. 
Agnes Digital visibly looked 
sleep-deprived.
